summary: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, revealing a major restructuring. The company disposed of subsidiaries, recognizing an $8.07 million loss on disposal, and shows a receivable of $21.0 million from the disposal, plus a $20.02 million digital assets consideration receivable. The balance sheet reflects a shift to continuing operations with minimal revenue ($1.0 million) and significant general and administrative expenses ($8.0 million). Common stock issued increased substantially from 6.6 million to 60.7 million shares. The filing indicates a strategic repositioning away from legacy metal products operations. Watch for further disclosures on the subsidiary sales and the digital asset transaction.
